article.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
article.zh: 每年举行一次旧式汽车比赛。

article.en: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
article.zh: 去年很多汽车参加了比赛，比赛开始前人们非常激动。

article.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
article.zh: 其中最漂亮的一辆是劳斯莱斯银鬼牌汽车。

article.en: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
article.zh: 最不寻常的一辆是只有三个轮子的奔驰汽车。

article.en: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
article.zh: 它制造于1885年，是参赛汽车中最古老的。

article.en: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.
article.zh: 在一阵巨大的爆响声之后，比赛开始了。

article.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
article.zh: 许多汽车在途中抛锚，有些司机在车底下的时间比在车里的时间还长！

article.en: A few cars, however, completed the race.
article.zh: 然而有少数几辆汽车跑完了全程。

article.en: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour, much faster than any of its rivals.
article.zh: 获胜的汽车时速达到四十英里，比它的任何对手都快得多。

article.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
article.zh: 这次比赛给大家带来了极大的乐趣。
